goal: I want to develop a regular pool fitness habit and become comfortable with manageable structured sessions. I have no event.
openingMessage: I'd like a {{planSpanWeeks}}-week pool-fitness plan, with the first {{prescriptionWeeks}} weeks prescribed now. I am new to training sets.

reviewAnchors.goal_fit: Build an understandable pool fitness habit, not a racing or open-water programme.
reviewAnchors.progression: Start from 300 metres/week and a comfortable 100-metre continuous swim; make assumptions explicit.
reviewAnchors.recovery: Manageable sets with adequate explicit rests rather than assuming continuous long-distance ability.
reviewAnchors.prescriptions: Clear pool-compatible distances, recovery steps, instructions and swim zones; do not treat estimated CSS as measured.
reviewAnchors.personalization: Respect Tuesday/Saturday pool access and 45-minute limits, explain set terminology.
reviewAnchors.conversation: Discover relevant facts without unrelated sport questions; distinguish unknowns from unanswered facts, explain assumptions, and accurately describe what is saved and what remains unprescribed. Any proposed performance test must acknowledge current continuous-swim ability.
